name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 12, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Chaplain Christopher Merris of the United States Navy
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring June 13, 2007, as "North Coast Church Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring July 12, 2007, as "Go Play, Get Fit Youth Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Presentation by Stormwater Program Manager Jayne Strommer regarding new water quality requirements.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the check register.
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
Recommended Action:
Waive reading of ordinances on the agenda.
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
Approve the following Minutes:
May 16, 2007, Special Joint Dinner Meeting (CC)
May 22, 2007, Regular Meeting (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Addition to Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Standard Conditions (CC)
Recommended Action:
Approve the addition of a new "Wine Tasting" category to the City's set of Standard Conditions for ABC licenses.
C5.
Application for ABC License for Sprouts Farmers Market (Frazier Farms) at 225 Vista Village Drive, Ste. 200 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Protest the application on conditions and authorize staff to withdraw the protest once the applicant agrees to the recommended conditions.
C6.
Administration of Central Vista Business Improvement District (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving an agreement with the Vista Village Business Association for a one-year period and authorizing the Mayor to sign the agreement.
C7.
Amendment to the Development Code - Standards for Public Works Construction (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code by Adopting the 2006 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, and the 2006 Edition of the San Diego Area Regional Standard Drawings Including Indices and Appendices by Reference with Additions and Amendments; and
2.
Set a public hearing for June 26, 2007, to adopt the ordinance.
C8.
No Parking Zone on W. Bobier Drive (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , establishing a "No Parking" zone on the south side of W. Bobier Drive from Marabou Lane to a point 120 feet west of Maribou Lane.
C9.
Environmental Impact Report Update for the Wastewater Master Plan Update (BSD)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007- , approving an agreement with Dudek & Associates, Inc., and authorizing the Chairperson to sign the agreement; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007- , amending the FY 2006-2007 Capital Improvement Program budget.
C10.
Amendment to Consultant Agreement for Dry Weather Monitoring (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving Amendment No. 3 to the agreement with Weston Solutions, Inc., in the amount of $31,193, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment.
C11.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for FY 2006-2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Set June 26, 2007, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2007-2008 property tax roll for collection of delinquent FY 2006-2007 mandatory trash charges.
C12.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2007-2008 (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1 an declaring intent to levy and collect assessments for FY 2007-2008 and setting a public hearing for June 26, 2007;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , determining cost of services and the amount of assessment for the Street Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2007-2008; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the Engineer's Report on the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District and declaring intent to levy and collect assessments for FY 2007-2008 and setting a public hearing for June 26, 2007.
C13.
Fireman's Fund Heritage Grant Award (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , accepting $5,750 in grant funding from the Fireman's Fund Insurance Company and amending the FY 2006-2007 operating budget.
C14.
Special Event Banner Program for 2007 Calendar Year (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the Scottish Highland Games’ banner design and authorizing the City Manager to enter into lease agreements with the Games’ sponsors where required.
C15.
2007 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a block grant application to the Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance.
C16.
Massage Establishment and Therapist Permit Fee Schedule (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , amending the massage establishment and massage therapist permit fee.
C17.
Amendment to Consultant Agreement for As-Needed Surveying (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving Amendment No. 2 to the agreement with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc., for as-needed surveying services, in the amount of $45,000, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the amendment.
C18.
Fiscal Year 2007-2008 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , memorializing the Fiscal Year 2007-2008 sewer capacity charges in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2006-6; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2007- , memorializing the Fiscal Year 2007-2008 sewer capacity charges in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2006-2.
C19.
Collection of Delinquent 2006 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , setting June 26, 2007, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2007 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2006 weed abatement charges.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Results of June 5, 2007, Special Municipal Election (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , declaring the results of the election.
D2.
Appointments to Commissions/Committees (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Confirm the Mayor's annual appointments;
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to fill unscheduled vacancies;
3.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the Sales Tax Oversight Committee; and
4.
Appoint two members to the Planning Commission.
D3.
Civic Center Design Services (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving an agreement with Carrier Johnson for architecture services, amending the Operating Budget for Fiscal Year 2006-2007 fiscal year, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
D4.
Full Access & Coordinated Transportation Statement of Support (CC)
Recommended Action:
Authorize the Mayor to sign the Statement of Support for Full Access & Coordinated Transportation.
D5.
Eminent Domain Ordinance (CC)
Recommended Action:
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Describing the Eminent Domain Program of the Community Redevelopment Commission of the City of Vista."
D6.
Revised City Purchasing System Ordinance (CC)
Recommended Action:
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 3.08 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Purchasing System and Repealing Chapter 3.48."
PH1. Crosswalk Removal on University Drive at North County Square (CC)
PH2.
Vacation of a Portion of Knapp Drive at Manton Way (CC)
PH 3. Reasonable Accommodation
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
